title: Pitchside overlay
description: A timed graphic that can be drawn over a live match feed. Times use the same clock as event t_ms, so a renderer can sync overlays to video.

anchor_t_ms.description: Match time of the moment the overlay is about.

start_t_ms.description: When to show it. Usually a few seconds after anchor_t_ms, like a broadcast delay.

priority.description: Higher pre-empts lower in the same slot.

profile_key.description: Audience, for example 'casual:en' or 'club:RVA:hi'. '*' means everyone.

verified.description: Agent text is only emitted when true.

fallback.description: True when a template line replaced the agent line.
